clips.title: The story
paras: During Winter Veil in Ironforge, the performer portraying Greatfather Winter asks passersby for a treat. Bring him freshly baked gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk, and he offers a festive gift with warm thanks.

In the Commons of Ironforge, a dwarf sits by the holiday tree dressed as Greatfather Winter. The figure’s roots lie in ancient titan lore and dwarven myths of an immortal being cloaked in winter’s chill, but modern festivities rely on Smokywood Pastures. For hours, the performer hears holiday wishes from citizens and eager children.

After hearing requests for gifts all day, the performer grows hungry. He asks for five freshly baked gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk. The simple meal gives an exhausted festival worker a moment of relief and spreads goodwill through Ironforge.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Hey, can you do Greatfather Winter a favor, um, little kid?

Not to needlessly talk about myself in the third person, but Greatfather Winter has been at this all day and he could use a treat himself. Some gingerbread cookies and ice cold milk to wash them down with would really hit the spot. Think you could be a friend to the Greatfather and fetch some for me?

clips.title: Progress
paras: All this talk of treats has given me a hankering for some myself. Mmmm... Gingerbread cookies and milk...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You're quite the helper to ol' Greatfather Winter there, friend. Have a great Feast of Winter Veil.
Here's a little something... You know, for the effort.
